ex.hz: 我想买一个新的照相机。
ex.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge xīn de zhàoxiàngjī.
ex.en: I want to buy a new camera.

ex.py: Wǒ de shū bèi péngyou jiè zǒu le.
ex.en: My book was borrowed by a friend.

ex.hz: 听到这个消息，他很难过。
ex.py: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā hěn nánguò.
ex.en: He was very sad to hear the news.

ex.py: Wǒ jiā zài xuéxiào de dōngbian.
ex.en: My home is east of the school.

ex.py: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ mǎi ma?
ex.en: Can I pay with a credit card?

words.en: to care about; to be interested in

ex.py: Bàba hěn guānxīn wǒ de xuéxí.
ex.en: Dad cares a lot about my studies.

ex.hz: 只有多练习，才能说得好。
ex.py: Zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, cái néng shuō de hǎo.
ex.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak well.

ex.hz: 他这次的考试成绩很好。
ex.py: Tā zhè cì de kǎoshì chéngjì hěn hǎo.
ex.en: His result in this exam was very good.

ex.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yí ge wǎn.

ex.hz: 这两个字很像，你能分出来吗？
ex.py: Zhè liǎng ge zì hěn xiàng, nǐ néng fēn chūlai ma?
ex.en: These two characters look alike; can you tell them apart?
This problem is easy to solve.

ex.hz: 你可以试一试这件衣服。
ex.py: Nǐ kěyǐ shì yi shì zhè jiàn yīfu.
ex.en: You can try on this piece of clothing.

ex.hz: 她真正喜欢的是画画儿。
ex.py: Tā zhēnzhèng xǐhuan de shì huà huàr.
ex.en: What she truly likes is drawing.
Look, how beautiful it is here!

lines.hz: 我的信用卡不见了，我真难过。
lines.py: Wǒ de xìnyòngkǎ bú jiàn le, wǒ zhēn nánguò.
lines.en: My credit card is missing; I'm really upset.

lines.hz: 你再找找，是不是被你放在公司了？
lines.py: Nǐ zài zhǎozhao, shì bu shì bèi nǐ fàng zài gōngsī le?
lines.en: Look again; did you leave it at the office?

lines.py: Wǒ yǐjīng zhǎo guo le, méi zhǎodào.
lines.en: I've looked already and haven't found it.

lines.hz: 别着急，明天我和你一起去商店问问。
lines.py: Bié zháojí, míngtiān wǒ hé nǐ yìqǐ qù shāngdiàn wènwen.
lines.en: Don't worry; tomorrow I'll go to the shop with you to ask.

options: Asking at the shop together tomorrow

lines.hz: 你的成绩怎么提高得这么快？
lines.py: Nǐ de chéngjì zěnme tígāo de zhème kuài?
lines.en: How did your grades improve so fast?

lines.hz: 我觉得只有真正喜欢学习，才能学好。
lines.py: Wǒ juéde zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng xǐhuan xuéxí, cái néng xué hǎo.
lines.en: I think only if you truly like studying can you do well.

lines.hz: 这么难的问题，你也能解决吗？
lines.py: Zhème nán de wèntí, nǐ yě néng jiějué ma?
lines.en: Can you solve even a problem this hard?

lines.hz: 不一定，不过我会试一试。
lines.py: Bù yídìng, búguò wǒ huì shì yi shì.
lines.en: Not necessarily, but I'll give it a try.

questions.q: What does B say is needed to study well?
What will B do with a hard problem?

grammar.en: S + 被 + (agent) + verb + other element: the passive

drills.en: Who rode off on my bike?
The cake was all eaten by my younger brother.

drills.q: 我的作业还没有___老师检查呢。
drills.en: My homework hasn't been checked by the teacher yet.

drills.q: 我昨天买的书___朋友借走了。
drills.en: The book I bought yesterday was borrowed by a friend.
The window was blown open by the wind.

drills.q: 照相机已经___弟弟用坏了。
drills.en: The camera has already been broken by my younger brother.

grammar.en: 只有 A，才 B: only if A, then B

drills.en: Only if you practise every day can you improve your level.

drills.q: 只有周末，他___有时间打篮球。
drills.en: Only at the weekend does he have time to play basketball.
Only by working hard can you get opportunities.

drills.q: 只有自己去过，你___能知道那儿有多漂亮。
drills.en: Only if you go yourself can you know how beautiful it is.

drills.q: 这个问题很难，只有王老师___能回答。
drills.en: This question is hard; only Teacher Wang can answer it.
Only if you study seriously can your grades improve.

lines: 数学成绩很好，可是英语差极了。
这两个杯子哪个是你的？
我也看不出来，它们太像了。
dialogs.q: 女的知道哪个杯子是她的吗？

judge.text: 我的照相机被朋友借走了，下个星期才能还给我。
judge.claim: 他的照相机在朋友那儿。

judge.text: 只有每天练习，汉语才能提高得快。
judge.claim: 不练习汉语也能提高得快。

judge.text: 这个学期我天天玩儿游戏，考试成绩很差。
他很难过，因为他的信用卡被别人拿走了。
judge.claim: 他的信用卡不在他那儿了。

replies.a: 我的照相机被人拿走了。
